# Homes and Gardens

> > Your complete guide to designing, decorating, and maintaining beautiful homes and gardens with expert advice, trending styles, and practical solutions.

Homes and Gardens is a comprehensive home design and lifestyle publication offering expert guidance across interior design, kitchen and bathroom remodeling, garden landscaping, and home decor shopping. The site features house tours, celebrity home inspiration, seasonal gardening tips, and practical solutions for everyday home living.

## Key Topics

- Interior Design
- Home Decor
- Kitchen Design
- Garden Design
- House Design
- Home Design Inspiration
- Garden Landscaping
- Bathroom Design
- Furniture Guide
- Plant Care
- Designer Homes
- Home Decor Shopping
- Outdoor Design
- House Tours
- Interior Decoration

## Core Design Categories

- [Interior Design](https://www.homesandgardens.com/interior-design): Interior design expert advice, color trends, room layouts, and design principles
- [Kitchen Design](https://www.homesandgardens.com/kitchens): Kitchen design trends, decor ideas, cabinetry, and remodeling planning for 2026
- [Garden Design](https://www.homesandgardens.com/gardens): Garden design ideas, trends, plant care, and landscaping guidance for 2026
- [House Design & Tours](https://www.homesandgardens.com/house-design): House design tours featuring homes from around the world with interior inspiration

## Expert Guides & How-To

- [How to Design a Kitchen](https://www.homesandgardens.com/kitchens/how-to-design-a-kitchen): Ultimate kitchen design guide covering layout, appliances, storage, and lighting
- [Low-Maintenance Potted Plants](https://www.homesandgardens.com/gardens/low-maintenance-pot-plants-that-thrive-on-neglect): Expert-recommended low-maintenance potted plants for easy indoor gardening
- [Spring Equinox Garden Tasks](https://www.homesandgardens.com/gardens/what-to-do-in-the-garden-on-spring-equinox): Spring equinox garden tasks and seasonal gardening tips from professionals
- [Solved: Home Solutions](https://www.homesandgardens.com/solved): Practical home solutions for sleep, cleaning, appliances, and everyday living

## Inspiration & Trends

- [Celebrity Homes](https://www.homesandgardens.com/celebrity-style): Celebrity home tours featuring interior design tricks and decor inspiration

- [Jennifer Aniston's Japanese Garden](https://www.homesandgardens.com/celebrity-style/jennifer-aniston-japanese-garden-planting-water-and-color): Jennifer Aniston's Japanese garden design with planting and water feature tips
